what: Phase 3: Integrate markdown documentation files into the knowledge graph
why: Enable mapping and indexing of spec and design markdown documentation, linking them to codebase nodes.
learned: Including .md files as 'document' type nodes in scanFiles and implementing a Markdown resolver (resolving relative paths, project paths, and wikilinks) provides cross-document structural context to the knowledge graph.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: Documentation markdown files and their references/wikilinks are parsed and linked. Test TestSyncGraphWithMarkdown validates the node/edge creation.
next_steps: Proceed to Phase 4: unified Obsidian vault export.
